_: Runtime strings for language `en`. Plugin source stays English; only what the user reads (journals, loaded context, CLAUDE.md block) is localized. Add a new language by copying this file to <code>.json - missing keys fall back to en.
prompts_header:
# Prompt journal (automatic)

Written by the ZoeyMemory hook `log-prompt.sh`: a marker per session plus every prompt the user sends.
This file is COMMITTED so the other machine can see what this one was asked to do.

Do not hand-edit the automatic lines. To record the OUTCOME of a task, add a line starting with `> `
right under the matching prompt. The REASONING behind a decision belongs in OpenSpec (`openspec/changes/<name>/`).
sessions_header:
# Session journal

Every time you leave a machine (`/zoey-memory:handoff`) append ONE new entry at the end, using this shape:

## YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM - branch `main` - machine <hostname>
- In progress: ...
- Why we stopped: ...
- Waiting on whom for what: ...
- The other machine needs to know (things outside git): ...

The `session-start.sh` hook loads the LATEST entry into the next session. Do not repeat `git log` -
commits answer "what changed", this entry answers "why, and what comes next".
ctx_title: # Context auto-loaded at session start (ZoeyMemory, hook session-start.sh)
ctx_intro: Read all of this BEFORE answering the first prompt. It is what happened in the previous session and/or ON THE OTHER MACHINE - do not re-ask what is already answered here, do not re-propose options already rejected. Division of labor: specs/decisions -> OpenSpec (/opsx:*) - TDD/debugging/verification/review -> superpowers - memory -> ZoeyMemory. Details in CLAUDE.md.
sync_fetch_slow: WARNING: git fetch took over 8s (slow/offline network?) - the origin comparison below may be STALE.
sync_pulled: OK: auto `git pull --ff-only` brought in {n} new commit(s) from {upstream} (tree was clean, so it was safe). FILES ON DISK JUST CHANGED - anything you remember about this repo may be outdated.
sync_dirty: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) but the working tree has UNCOMMITTED CHANGES, so no auto-pull. Settle the in-progress work (commit/stash) and `git pull` BEFORE continuing.
sync_diverged: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) and has DIVERGED (local commits not pushed). Needs a deliberate rebase/merge - ask the user before deciding.
sync_unpushed: WARNING: {n} commit(s) from the previous session are NOT PUSHED - `git push` soon or the other machine will not see them.

## OpenSpec
No open changes. New work worth remembering -> `/opsx:propose <name>`.
openspec_missing:
## OpenSpec
OpenSpec is NOT initialized in this repo (no `openspec/`). Run `/zoey-memory:init`.
